entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3 13-09-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State .

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 420,
406, 409, 467, 468 , 469 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code .

3 . As per prosecution case , this petitioner while working as Principal of Mohammad Hussain Azad National (M. H . A . N .) Degree College , Thhakurganj has embezzled the government money to the tune of Rs. 1.5 Crores in conspiracy with co-accused Faruk Alam in different transaction .

entities.text: Mohammad Hussain Azad National (M. H . A . N .) Degree College , Thhakurganj
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he has falsely been implicated in this case due to enmity .

The Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.36721 of 2024(3) dt.13-09-2024 present case is counter blast of Thakurganj P S Case No. 108 of 2021 in which petitioner Muzammal Haque is informant and the informant of this case is accused.

5 . Learned counsel for the State as well as informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that petitioner is named in the F.I.R. with specific accusation that he embezzled the government money and caused loss to the tune of Rs. 1.5 Crores.
6. Considering the nature of accusation and gravity of offence , prayer for pre-arrest bail of the petitioner is rejected.
